beatOutlines.textOutline: At 11 AM, Raju grew excited seeing a breakout on Kesar Paints.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji stopped Raju, pointing out a 40-day cycle timer on the chart.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju hastily placed a heavy long trade at ₹450.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju took a position right at the cycle crest at ₹450.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: As the downward cycle phase started, the stock tumbled down to ₹395.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Charts don't just show what to buy; cycles reveal when to buy.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The first pillar consists of basic cycle elements: Amplitude, Period, and Phase.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The second pillar is J.M. Hurst's four foundational principles: Summation, Harmonicity, Synchronicity, and Proportionality.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The third pillar is trend translation and macro seasonal cycles like the January Barometer and Presidential Cycle.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

scenes.title: Anatomy of a Cycle: Amplitude, Period, Phase
scenes.concept: Anatomy of a Cycle: Amplitude, Period, Phase

beatOutlines.textOutline: Period is the time elapsed between two successive troughs, measured in days or weeks.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Amplitude is the vertical height of the wave reflecting the magnitude of the price swing.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Phase measures where the wave currently stands in its cycle at a given point in time.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

takeaways: Anatomy of a Cycle: Amplitude, Period, Phase

beatOutlines.textOutline: The first principle is Summation: a price chart is the composite sum of all active cycles.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The second principle is Harmonicity: adjacent cycles relate by integer multiples like 2 or 3.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The third principle is Synchronicity: diverse cycle lengths tend to bottom together at the exact same time.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The fourth principle is Proportionality: cycles with longer time periods naturally produce larger price swings.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

scenes.title: Dominant Cycles: Isolating the Market Pulse
scenes.concept: Dominant Cycles: Isolating the Market Pulse

beatOutlines.textOutline: Hundreds of waves exist, but only Dominant Cycles consistently offer profitable trades.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Random noise forms without mathematical regularity and traps traders in false breakouts.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Technical analysts always combine dominant cycle bottoms with a primary trend filter.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

takeaways: Dominant Cycles: Isolating the Market Pulse

beatOutlines.textOutline: In the absence of a trend, the cycle crest forms perfectly in the center.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: However, in a bull market, the crest shifts to the right, termed Right Translation.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Left Translation warns that the underlying trend has flipped and bears are in command.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Certain calendar months show robust seasonal bias driven by institutional inflows and tax planning.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Between May and October the market often softens, colloquially dubbed 'Sell in May'.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: When seasonal tailwinds and a short-term cycle trough coincide, win rates peak.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The January Barometer states: as goes January, so goes the rest of the year.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In the 4-year Presidential Cycle, the first two years tend to be sluggish, while the final two rally.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Particularly the third, pre-election year historically delivers the strongest returns.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Now it's your turn. Read the question on the screen carefully.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Think. Which side of the center has the crest formed?
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The correct answer: Left Translation, indicating strong bearish trend pressure.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Before market close, Raju approached Sharma ji with his chart notebook.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji smiled and checked the confirmation at the cycle bottom.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju understood that smart traders buy at cycle troughs, never at cycle peaks.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The entire essence of cycle theory can be understood across eight critical steps.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Cycles are always measured trough-to-trough, and horizontal time duration is the period.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Hurst's principles demonstrate how multiple underlying waves combine into the final chart.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Underlying trend pressure shifts the cycle crest toward the right or the left.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The January Barometer and Presidential Cycle set the broader direction for annual market momentum.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Today's lesson: Price indicates direction while cycles reveal time; always buy at synchronized troughs.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

summarySteps: Period is time, Amplitude is price height, Phase is cycle position
Summation: price action is the combined sum of all waves
Harmonicity links waves by 2:1 ratios; Synchronicity aligns troughs
Proportionality ensures longer cycle periods command larger amplitudes
Right Translation signals bull markets; Left Translation flags bear trends
Seasonal and calendar patterns align macro institutional liquidity
High-probability trades synchronize dominant cycle troughs with the trend
bottomTakeaway: Discipline and grounded market understanding are essential for survival.
